text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Aah... It's over...
I ate way too much while cooped up in there...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Rulership showed up for the meeting,
he seemed terribly down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My weight...
has gone up insanely high...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Counting calories is such a pain...
Exercising is annoying... I don't wanna move...
Dieting is totally impossible for me...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Your 'great idea'... was table tennis?
That's just more exercise in the end!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I explained that table tennis isn't just physical exercise,
but a chess-like game that demands
intense psychological warfare and strategy."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
choice_data_list: Let's just give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"What is required is meticulous strategy
and the ability to instantly determine the optimal move!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Table tennis is a battle of wits decided in split seconds.
Fascinating... This is extraordinarily fascinating!!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying...!
You're the one who dragged me onto this board.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You're keeping me company until I'm satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as expected, she got completely hooked on table tennis.
We continued playing matches whenever there was time...
and she successfully managed to lose weight.
